mapper.select: SELECT relation.id, source.name AS source_name, source.entity_type AS source_type, relation.relation_type, target.name AS target_name, target.entity_type AS target_type, relation.description, relation.confidence, relation.review_status FROM knowledge_relation relation JOIN knowledge_entity source ON source.id = relation.source_entity_id JOIN knowledge_entity target ON target.id = relation.target_entity_id WHERE relation.book_id = #{bookId} AND (relation.source_entity_id = #{knowledgeEntityId} OR relation.target_entity_id = #{knowledgeEntityId}) ORDER BY relation.id
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{bookId}
